title: Retry deferred bottom restoration across renewed scroll cooldowns
outcome: When virtualized page measurement occurs at physical bottom during the user-scroll cooldown, the new deferred path schedules one layout-version bump. If another scroll input refreshes the cooldown before that timer fires, the layout effect returns early and nothing re-arms restoration, leaving the refined spacer committed without a bottom repin until unrelated layout work. The same path currently forces flushSync during cooldown even though the paired scroll write is deferred. Make deferred restoration re-check and reschedule against the latest input timestamp, avoid unnecessary synchronous layout work during the cooldown, and add deterministic fake-timer integration coverage.
acceptance: No immediate bottom write occurs during active user-scroll cooldown; after the latest input cooldown expires the viewport restores exactly once even when input renewed the cooldown; page measurement does not force an unpaired synchronous render during cooldown; tests advance timers and observe the final restored viewport; TypeScript and full Vitest pass.
